title: Server actions acceptKol/skipKol/swapKol + audit_log + 5s Undo state
acceptance: src/app/[locale]/(app)/match/server-actions/suggestion-actions.ts: acceptKolToCampaign(kolId, campaignId), skipKolFromCampaign(kolId, campaignId), swapKolToSwapPool(kolId, campaignId), undoLastDecision(decisionId)

acceptKol: UPSERT kol_campaign (kolId, campaignId, suggestionStatus='accepted', decidedAt=now, source='ai_smart_match'); audit_log 'kol.campaign_suggestion_decided' payload={action:'accept', kolId, campaignId, actorUserId, undoExpiresAt}
skipKol: UPSERT kol_campaign (kolId, campaignId, suggestionStatus='skipped', decidedAt=now); 下次 getCampaignSuggestions 自动排除 skipped (per F004 WHERE)
swapKol: UPSERT kol_campaign (kolId, campaignId, suggestionStatus='swap_pool', decidedAt=now); 候补列 query 抓 swap_pool 状态行
undoLastDecision: 接 decisionId (audit_log row id), 5s 内可撤; 撤销 = DELETE kol_campaign 行 + audit_log 'kol.campaign_suggestion_undone'; 超 5s → 错 'undo expired'
事务原子性: kol_campaign 写 + audit_log 写同 $transaction; 失败 rollback 整体
F004 cache 失效: 任一 server action 跑 → 删 cache key (强制下次 refresh)
单测 ≥6 case (3 actions × accept+undo / skip / swap)
L1 PASS
